up: Retrieve the preferred names and canonical SMILES of all compounds tested against the human target Lysine-specific demethylase 4E (CHEMBL1293226). Filter assays by joining with target_dictionary where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293226'. Join the resulting activity records with molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno to fetch the compound names and canonical SMILES. Return distinct compound names and their canonical SMILES. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293226'
